worldcombat.skill.thundershock.summary: A short, point-blank electric jab that lands instantly. Its range is tiny but it barely costs a beat; against a target already paralysed it hits harder and tops the paralysis up. Electric types are immune to paralysis.
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.descripti: The jab strikes along a straight line at a target within %2$s blocks, dealing about %1$s special damage with a collision radius of %3$s blocks; the line must be clear. If another creature stands on the line, the first one takes the jab instead: an enemy is struck, an ally draws the current away.
On a hit there is a %1$s chance to paralyse the target for %2$s; if the target is already paralysed, the paralysis is topped up to at least %3$s (never shortened) and the jab hits about 1.38x harder.
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.timing: Needs line of sight: range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.growth.0: From level %1$s the jab power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.growth.1: From level %1$s the paralysis chance rises to %2$s and the top-up lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.use.0: A quick jab to press someone at close range
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.use.1: Follow up on a target already paralysed
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.use.2: Chip in during a close brawl
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.preferenc: Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of jabbing; a larger value chases further, but its range is tiny so long chases rarely pay off.
When on, a paralysed target gets much higher priority - this jab hits it harder and extends the paralysis; when off, it ranks as an ordinary melee attack.
When on, the companion may leave its post to jab; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.thundershock.descripti: While paralysed, the target moves at half speed and every attempt to act has a 25% chance to fail; Electric-type targets cannot be paralysed.
